notes.title: VN Fest + DLC release + KS prelaunch
notes.content:
We've got an exciting month ahead of us this March!

First off, Wrong Number is taking part in Visual Novel Fest this week! 
A celebration of amazing visual novel style games, focused on story telling, beautiful artwork, and meaningful choices. 
Get the Wrong Number game at a 20% discount until March 11th (AEST).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981281/c60667f3f564e9678993eec44bfab5c8bc5ac5ce.png

Second order of news, today we've released two of our short story ebooks!
These two short and spicy stories take place directly after the events of the Wrong Number game. They follow Luka and Xander after they've began a physical relationship and are honestly more of an indulgence than anything. Haha. 
Both stories launched with a 40% discount to celebrate their release here on Steam. 
Please be aware, these are NOT visual novel games, they are ebooks. Check the provided screenshot on their pages for preview.
>> Going 69 in a 50 zone > On the 69th day of Xmas > Follow to be notified when we go LIVE <<
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981281/0ee1696f5f8420674d279139fa842baa7afc521f.png

notes.title: Official Steam Release Date
notes.content:
Put it in your calendars! Set yourself a reminder! 

Wrong Number will be releasing on Tuesday the 5th of November 2024 (AEST)

In less than a week, players will be able to play as Luka, a carefree guy that just likes to have fun. And what's more fun that convincing a stranger you meet over the phone to come hang out with you? 
Will Luka and Xander's relationship grow into something sweet and romantic? Or be purely physical in nature? 

I'm so excited to share this game with more people and hope players enjoy the silly banter between characters.

notes.title: Development Log
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I see a lot of new people joining us thanks to Steam Next Fest, and I just wanted to give everyone an update on Wrong Number's development so far.

Achievements Added

It's my first time implementing achievements into one of my games. Honestly, I was having a lot of trouble getting it to work, but thanks to a recent Ren'Py update everything has now been fixed and I am so happy with how the achievements run in the game. Woohoo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981281/8dc4d1a8a1cee73e618fdff86f3b0f1e5017925c.png

Final CG Illustration

Only one CG illustration is left to do!! 
We'll have a total of nine illustrations (some SFW and some NSFW) in the game's steam release. I am really hoping to add more, depending on how well Wrong Number is received here on steam.
If you haven't yet, consider wishlisting the game and leaving a review! It really helps with the game's development.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981281/08ae3c611f24b9a0794e964d6bb939780b3a51f8.png

Release Date?

We're waiting to hear back from the Steam Review team, but if everything runs on schedule you can expect Wrong Number is come out on steam in November! I'll update this when I'm certain.
